reference.purpose: Reproduce an external program before claiming SARscope numerical equivalence
reference.isolation: Execute unmodified program in a separate temporary checkout/environment. Do not import, copy, translate or derive SARscope methods from its source. No GPL source consulted.

dataset.activity_transformation: None: the author's split files already store positive pActivity
dataset.coordinates: Use deposited alignment and explicit hydrogens unchanged in the reference execution
dataset.redistribution: Do not bundle upstream SDFs; retain hashes, accounting and derived numerical results only

predeclared_tolerances.note: Diagnostic tolerances, not grounds to tune parameters or discard compounds. A running CLI alone does not satisfy these targets.

environment.python: 3.12 (available locally; paper used 3.11, so this is a recorded deviation)

acceptance: All valid 21 training and 10 test compounds accounted for; unreadable source records explicitly reported
Unmodified reference command succeeds and produces finite outputs before any SARscope equivalence claim
Extract or export reference intermediates/predictions by documented interfaces, not source-code translation
Compare identical charges, coordinates, grid and field columns before fitting PLS
Separate historical-protocol emulation from SARscope's training-only preprocessing
Keep test-independent model development; these already-inspected test compounds are a reproduction fixture, not fresh validation
SEH success would not establish hydrogen-bond-field or CoMFA reproduction

alternative.reference: Ragno (2019), Py-CoMFA, J Comput Aided Mol Des 33:855-864
alternative.reason_not_first: 30 pre-aligned datasets reported, but source and intermediate reference outputs were not established as directly accessible in this search; institutional preprint download returned 403

own_loo_protocol.purpose: Matched published-style LOO reproduction on source-flagged THR inputs; not native predictive validation
own_loo_protocol.prior_exposure: The THR historical split and nested-CV scores have been inspected. This is a retrospective diagnostic, not fresh validation or a passing demo.
own_loo_protocol.method_source: Haga et al. 2025, doi:10.3390/ph18030440, Methods4.4-4.7 and Table3
own_loo_protocol.implementation: Own SARscope field calculation, historical standardisation, capped-by-rank LOO component search and genuine predictions; external executable serves only as an isolated comparator

data.source_quality: 59/59 training graphs encode a radical electron, versus0/29 test. This is a source-format concern, not evidence of actual experimental radicals. No graph repair or exclusion is permitted in this historical reproduction.
data.coordinate_policy: Retain deposited frame and explicit hydrogens; no embedding, minimisation or tautomer/protonation repair

historical_preprocessing.scaling: One population SD over each full field block across train and test, followed by separate train/test column centres; transductive benchmark-only representation
historical_preprocessing.component_selection: Maximum LOO q2 over the complete1-12 count search; LOO score conditional on this historical representation, not nested CV
historical_preprocessing.test_prediction: Never add measured test mean to the genuine own prediction; any oracle-adjusted quantity remains a separately labelled diagnostic
historical_preprocessing.negative_control: Shift only held-out labels by+10. Any resulting change to fitted predictions disqualifies the reference export as prospective prediction.

own_loo_protocol.tolerance_rationale: Published THR metrics have two decimal places. These reproduction tolerances are fixed before this matched-LOO run, not predictive qualification criteria.
own_loo_protocol.scope: Five-field own approximation compared to published-style reference execution; H-bond field definitions differ and no exact five-field parity is asserted. Poor or mismatched outcomes remain recorded. Source chemistry must be adjudicated before any app-demo or model-qualification claim.

scope: Historical matched-LOO diagnostic; radical-encoded inputs not qualified for native models
prediction_audit: Compare training-mean-restored estimator outputs and exports separately; shift only test labels by+10
